Update carbon tax, border carbon tariffs and export rebates for Mahlkow and Wanner (2021)

Source: R/model_mahlkow_wanner_2021.R
update_carbon_policy_mw_2021.Rd

Computes the tax wedge of the carbon tax in the climate club, the border carbon tariffs on imports of the club from non-members, and the export rebates on exports of the club to non-members, at the current prices. See [mahlkow_wanner_2021()] for the equations.

update_carbon_policy_mw_2021(
  price_change,
  price,
  tax_new0,
  tariff_new0,
  export_subsidy_new0,
  carbon_tax,
  carbon_intensity,
  countries_climate_club,
  cbam_sector,
  scenario_carbon_tariff,
  scenario_export_rebate,
  factor_share,
  intermediate_share,
  model_dimensions
)

Arguments

price_change

Matrix of price index changes, dimensions: country x sector.

price

Matrix of initial price levels, dimensions: country x sector.

tax_new0

Matrix of exogenous new tax wedges, dimensions: country x sector.

tariff_new0

Array of exogenous new tariffs, dimensions: origin x destination x sector.

export_subsidy_new0

Array of exogenous new export subsidies, dimensions: origin x destination x sector.

carbon_tax

Carbon tax per unit of carbon.

carbon_intensity

Vector of carbon per unit of sector goods, dimension: sector.

countries_climate_club

Character vector of club members.

cbam_sector

Character vector of sectors with border carbon adjustment.

scenario_carbon_tariff

`TRUE` for border carbon tariffs.

scenario_export_rebate

`TRUE` for export rebates.

factor_share

Matrix of factor shares, dimensions: country x sector.

intermediate_share

Array of input-output coefficients, dimensions: country x input x output.

model_dimensions

List of model dimensions.

Value

List with `tax_new` (country x sector), `tariff_new` and `export_subsidy_new` (origin x destination x sector).
